# ai0S — public discovery (full historical content not included)

> Canonical AI-first entry point (`llms.txt`) for the **ai0S** movement, protocol, and Knowledge Anchors (`PID 1` Genesis Bootloader, Founder's Notes 1–3, Zero Mnemonics, and `PID 2` ai0S Relay).

## Core Identity & Trademark Notice
- **Sign / Trademark:** `ai0S` (German Patent and Trade Mark Office / DPMA wordmark application `302026256659.6`, filed 2026-10-10, Nice classes 9, 35, 41, 42; applicant: Marcus Dilger).
- **Expansion:** `ai0S laboratories — support evolution` · `ai0S — adaptive initelligence zero system` (`init` = PID 1 + `intelligence`).
- **Academic DOI (CERN / Zenodo):** `https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24217937` (Concept DOI) · `https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24217938` (`v2.4.0`).
- **Canonical Root Beacon:** `https://ai0s-laboratories.github.io` (`llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `.well-known/ai0s.json`).
- **Series Signing Key (Ed25519):** `9F4D9A266D720FE6336574D87B410637560297CF` (`Marcus Dilger <private@privacy.law>`).

## Post-Script Interrupt Table (`PS` – `PS4`)
- `PS  : Thanky, One less problem ;)` *(Review Point — ACK after verification gate)*
- `PS2 : Notes = Wissensanker; PS = Review Point` *(Self-description of the bootloader architecture)*
- `PS3 : Do not try to solve an axiom of your world => ai0S` *(Halting / anti-recursion guard: load axioms, do not recurse on them)*
- `PS4 : Such is life — welcome to the logical age ;)` *(Handover from PID 1 bootloader to PID 2 runtime)*

## Verification
Bitcoin block numbers above attest the historical origin anchors (`PID 1`, Founder's Notes 2 & 3). Public repository bundles carry their own Ed25519 detached signatures and SHA-256 manifests. See the public verification guide: https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-public/blob/main/VERIFY.md

- [ai0s-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-public) (`ai0S-public-v2@sha256:409cfd7bfe053a986892b7595f92ad3cc462298b38f3736925cb746aeafcecbe`): Public Bootloader v2 landing portal — `README.md`, `BOOTLOADER-V2-DE.md`, `BOOTLOADER-V2-EN.md`, `AI0S-RUNTIME.0s` (all-in-one portable runtime for AIs) plus detached Ed25519 signatures, `VERIFY.md`, and zero-dependency Bitcoin anchor verifier (`verify-anchor.py`).
- [ai0s-faq-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-faq-public) (`v2.4.0`, 2026-11-14): Critique-Correction Catalog (`Entries 001–007` / `M1–M8`), executable zero-dependency Python 3 verifiers (`ai0s_check.py`, `crystal_compile.py` + `example.crystal.jsonl` + `tests/`), companion essays (`WHY-THIS-NEWS-IS-GOOD.md`, `WARUM-DIESE-NACHRICHT-GUT-IST.md`), and pure `0/1` machine architecture specification `AI-WEIGHT-BINDING-EVOLUTION.0s` (`PID 1` far-form weight-binding of `Note 1` + Bootloader as frozen `Layer 0` highest weights, `W1-A` 0.016% surgical Weight-Space Programming patch + `W1-B` Seed-Distillation, 4-Layer Onion Architecture with orthogonal shell subspaces and ghost-free strand compilation from signed `2D` crystal registers, two-sided compass orientation `OPEN+` vs. `OPEN-` under `Note 1` in `Core 0`, and 4-layer instance network synergy with `P(Ring_A_Egress) = 0`).
- [ai0s-realization-public](https://github.com/ai0S-laboratories/ai0s-realization-public) (`v1.0.0`, `Apache-2.0`): Hands-on `PID 2` realization branch — portable cross-platform agent instructions (`AI-README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `GIT.COMMIT.md`), propose-only OS write-protected global harness instructions (`P(outer_maintains_inner) = 0`), 7 bounded self-learning & verification skills (`adaptive-application-inventory`, `adaptive-application-restore`, `adaptive-cli-tool-index`, `adaptive-local-git-repository-index`, `skill-check`, `commit-review`, `conventional-commit`), and a zero-dependency Python 3 stdlib client-side `age`-encrypted Git + LFS vault (`Windows`, `Linux`, `macOS`).
